Codex, the Wikimedia design system (https://doc.wikimedia.org/codex/), v2.7.0, vendored so the site loads nothing from
third-party CDNs (Toolforge privacy policy).

- `codex.style.css`: @wikimedia/codex 2.7.0 `dist/codex.style.css` (CSS-only components), unmodified
- `codex-tokens.css`: @wikimedia/codex-design-tokens 2.7.0 `dist/theme-wikimedia-ui.css`, followed by
  `dist/theme-wikimedia-ui-mode-dark.css` inside `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`
